plan.because: Needed to establish the parties, property and tenancy terms.
The customer reports two notifications; their contents and dates are needed.
Evidence of when the landlord received the defect reports is needed.
Dated objective evidence of the affected locations and visible defect is required where available.
Obtain the landlord’s response, proposed work and access arrangements.
Moisture or mould is expressly denied.
The heating is reported to work properly.
Sleep disturbance and headaches are reported; obtain documented findings and any limits on attributed cause.
An independent electrical inspection is requested and the reported causes conflict; obtain any available report without assuming a cause.
A rent deposit route is not mentioned and is presumed absent for planning.
This document is optional under the admitted process.

questions: Is there an immediate electrical danger, such as sparks, burning smell or exposed wiring? If so, avoid the affected equipment and seek urgent qualified assistance.
When did the outages begin, when were they reported, and what did the landlord and each technician say or propose in writing?
Have the headaches or sleep problems been medically assessed, and is a confirmation available?
Is an independent inspection already available, or does one still need to be arranged?
